title: feat(pm): pace every seat write — one shared throttle in front of the five write scripts (#19572)
body:
Fixes #19572

Clause-②: no

Filed and dispatched by the director seat under the maintainer's verbatim ruling:

> 截流应该要加

(chat, 2026-09-21) — the sentence #208 R6 requires before a new instrument. Two seat accounts
were suspended by the platform earlier the same day during bulk issue operations. This PR makes
pacing a property of the write path rather than of who remembered it.

## What lands

**`scripts/pm/write-pace.mjs`** — one helper, two calls, no third responsibility. It reads no
body, judges no card and changes nothing a write says. It answers one question, asked immediately
before a request leaves: may this write go now, and if not now, after how long a pause — or not at
all?

The three rules, defaults as the charter states them:

| rule | default | what happens |
|:---|:---|:---|
| ① minimum gap | 3 s per token | the remainder is **slept**, and the pause prints one line saying so |
| ② trailing-hour budget | 40 writes per token | the 41st is **REFUSED** — exit `10`, with a prescription. ⛔ Never a silent wait |
| ③ back-off marker | 30 min, or `retry-after` when that reaches further | every write by that token is refused, with the marker's expiry printed, until it expires |

The log is `~/.cache/objectstack-pm/write-pace.jsonl` (`OS_PM_WRITE_PACE_FILE` moves it), one JSON
line per write, keyed by `tokenKey()` — a 12-hex prefix of the token's SHA-256. ⛔ The token itself
never reaches the file, in any field. `OS_PM_WRITE_MIN_GAP_MS` and `OS_PM_WRITE_HOURLY_MAX` override
① and ② **for tests**; a malformed override is IGNORED and said out loud, because an override that
silently loosens a budget is worse than one that is refused.

Exit `10` is distinct from every code the five calling tools use (their highest is 9), so a seat
reading an exit code can always tell "the throttle stopped me" from anything the tool itself decided.

### Four design points worth reading before the diff

- **`classifyHttp` is reused by VALUE, never re-derived.** `label-write.mjs` already owns "what does
  this status mean", and its `ratelimit` arm is handed to `noteResponse` as `verdict` by the two
  callers that already hold it. ⛔ It is not imported: that module pulls the half-states patrol in
  behind it, and a throttle every write path loads must not drag a 26k-line gate into every process.
  What the throttle adds is the signals that classifier does not answer, and none of them is a copy
  of it — a 429 whose quota is not exhausted, a 403 whose BODY names the secondary limit, a bare
  `retry-after`, and `x-ratelimit-remaining: 0` on ANY status including the 200 that spent the last unit.
- **Reserve, then sleep.** The decision and the record of it are taken under one `mkdir` lock, and the
  sleep happens after the lock is released: the record's timestamp is the instant the write will be
  ISSUED. A second process asking while the first is still sleeping sees the reservation and paces
  behind it. The lock FAILS OPEN — it can only ever cost precision, never a seat's ability to write.
- **Dry runs are excluded STRUCTURALLY.** This file has no idea what a dry run is and must not. The
  guard is `isWriteMethod()` in each transport, and every `--dry-run` path in those tools returns
  before it issues a write request at all. Proven below with a positive control, not asserted.
- **Every line goes to stderr.** `post-stamped.mjs` prints the rendered body to stdout and `--json`
  after it; a pacing line on stdout would corrupt both. `--status` is the one command whose report
  is stdout, because reading it IS the output.

## The census of write sites, and each one's two calls

`git grep -n "method: 'POST'|'PATCH'|'PUT'|'DELETE'" scripts/pm` finds twelve write sites in five
files. The wiring is per **transport**, not per site, so all twelve are covered by five pairs:

| file | transport | write sites it issues | `paceWrite` before | `noteResponse` after |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| `post-stamped.mjs` | `rest` | comment `POST` (2586), body `PATCH` (2590) | 2547 | 2565 (refusal path, carrying the platform's own sentence) · 2573 (2xx path) |
| `label-write.mjs` | `rest` | label `POST`/`DELETE`, assignee `POST`/`DELETE`, the whole-set `PATCH` fallback, the re-add `POST` (538–541, 585, 626) | 335 | 363, with `classifyHttp`'s verdict handed over |
| `close-cards.mjs` | `rest` | the closing `PATCH` (651) | 445 | 471, with `classifyHttp`'s verdict handed over |
| `sweep-closed-cards.mjs` | `rest` | one `DELETE` per residue label (622), one comment `POST` (633) | 502 | 517 (refusal path) · 522 (2xx path) |
| `sweep-stale-finding.mjs` | `restLive` | the one `DELETE` that strips the stale grade (424) | 360 | 374 (refusal path) · 381 (2xx path) |

Line numbers are the post-merge ones. `close-cards.mjs` posts its comment by spawning
`post-stamped.mjs` as a child, so that write is paced by post-stamped's own transport rather than
twice. `ensure-pm-labels.sh` runs through `gh` under the maintainer's hand and stays out, as the
card directs.

On the two sweeps and post-stamped's refusal path the response body is now read before the throw —
only to be CLASSIFIED, because a secondary-rate-limit 403 names itself in prose and nowhere else.
The error objects carry exactly what they carried before.

## The self-test — 64 cases across 9 batteries

`node scripts/pm/write-pace.mjs --self-test` — offline, injected clock, injected sleep, injected
exit; nothing waits three real seconds and nothing touches the real cache file. Floor is the battery
ROSTER, not a total, and the verdict sets `selfTestReachedVerdict` as its last statement.

| battery | floor | what it pins |
|:---|---:|:---|
| the token key: enough to separate identities, useless as a credential | 6 | 12-hex prefix, determinism, two tokens are two budgets, ⛔ the key is not a prefix of the token, a token-less path still paces |
| the write-verb predicate: a read is never paced | 5 | the four verbs, `GET`/`HEAD`/omitted, and that case is not a way to dodge it |
| the limits: overrides are for tests, and a malformed one never loosens | 6 | defaults are the contract; `4O` falls back to 40 AND says so; `-1` is malformed; `0` is a real value |
| rule ①: the remainder is slept, and the pause is said out loud | 7 | first write does not pause; a write 1 s later sleeps 2 s not 3; after the gap, zero; the gap is PER TOKEN |
| rule ②: the 41st is REFUSED, with a prescription | 8 | forty pass, the 41st refuses at exit 10, it did NOT sleep instead, the text names the count / the reopen instant / what to fold, and a refused write reserves NOTHING |
| rule ③: what writes a stop marker, how long it lasts, what it refuses | 10 | 429, secondary-limit 403, `x-ratelimit-remaining: 0` on a **200**, `classifyHttp`'s verdict as an input; ⛔ a plain 403 writes none; a long `retry-after` wins and a short one does not shorten; refused while live, allowed once expired |
| the prune: the trailing hour for writes, the expiry for markers | 6 | old writes dropped, an EXPIRED marker dropped, ⛔ an unexpired two-hour marker survives the hour it outlives, a torn line is dropped not fatal, and the file on disk is rewritten pruned |
| the log, --status and the CLI: what lands on disk, and what must never | 9 | **THE case** — the token never appears in the file; `--status` counts the window, names the marker, never prints the token and spends no budget; the CLI exits 0, and a typo is usage |
| the wiring: both halves, in every write transport, on write verbs only | 7 | the five tools each import the throttle and call both halves under `isWriteMethod`; and the roster IS the set of files under `scripts/pm` that issue a write verb, so a SIXTH write path cannot land unpaced |

That last battery masks comments through the shared `js-comment-mask` (imported inside the battery,
so the hot path stays a throttle) and skips any line carrying a regex-delimiter spelling of the
pattern — three gates in that directory pin their own report-only-ness against a regex literal of
exactly this shape, and reading those as write sites would demand a throttle on a file that cannot
write at all.

```
✓ write-pace self-test: 64 cases pass across 9 batteries — the per-token key that never carries the
token, the gap remainder, the 41st refusal and its prescription, the stop marker a 429 writes, the
prune that keeps a long retry-after alive, and the five write transports that call both halves.
```

## A real `post-stamped.mjs --dry-run`, unchanged

Run against `objectstack-ai/objectstack#19572` with a body carrying one quoted reading:

```
$ node scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs --repo=objectstack-ai/objectstack --comment=19572 \
    --file=dryrun-body.md --dry-run
:: exit 0

post-stamped: DRY RUN — nothing was written. Substituted with `2026-09-21T09:44Z` — 0 {{NOW}},
1 quoted · verbatim: 0 opener(s) inside a quoted span, left exactly as written (none). Stamp
verdict: stamped-by-declaration — nothing was substituted and a `{{WAS:…}}` rendered from its own
declaration, so the artefact is stamped as a reading of something else. Target would be
objectstack-ai/objectstack#19572 (comment).
```

Two readings, because "unchanged" deserves better than a glance:

1. **Against the pre-change tree.** The same command run from a detached worktree at the merge base
   `b3615f1a4c` produces stdout and stderr **byte-identical** to the run above, with only the clock
   stamp normalised.
2. **A positive control, which is the stronger half.** Re-running the dry run under
   `OS_PM_WRITE_HOURLY_MAX=0 OS_PM_WRITE_MIN_GAP_MS=600000` — settings that would refuse ANY paced
   write at exit 10, or hang it for ten minutes — gives **exit 0 and byte-identical stdout and
   stderr**, and `OS_PM_WRITE_PACE_FILE` is **never created**. A dry run that had reached the
   throttle could not produce that result. Structural exclusion, measured.

## Gates

Derived on this branch's own diff, exit codes captured before any pipe:

```
node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack
  -> 68 command(s), 8 path(s) vs merge base b3615f1a4c, 1082 changed lines
node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran ran.list          :: exit 0
  -> 68 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 63 run, 5 NOT-MEASURED (5 DERIVED from a
     recorded exit 3), 0 UNRUN.
```

**63 of 68 green.** The other five all answered `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` at **exit 3** — NOT MEASURED,
neither a pass nor a finding — because each reads a built `dist/` closure this container has not
built: `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`,
`check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`, `check:type-check-debt`. This diff contains **zero** paths
under `packages/**`, so none of the five has an input this branch can move; CI builds the closure
and runs all five.

`check:pm-dispatch-gates` was run detached per its own header (the battery took 831.4 s on this box,
past the container's foreground cap): `✓ dispatch-gates self-test: 1883 cases pass.` :: exit 0.

Also run, named in the dispatch and outside the derived 68: `pnpm check:pm-settings-deny-roster`
(exit 0) and `pnpm check:pm-governed-prose` (exit 0). The five wired tools' own self-tests are in
the 68 and all green — post-stamped 544 cases, close-cards 102, sweep-stale-finding 91,
sweep-closed-cards 87, label-write 75.

Fourteen further families "apply once this card's changeset exists" — see the next section.

## Landing tier

```
$ node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --branch claude/issue-19572-write-pace
:: exit 0

derived from `git diff --name-only --no-renames b3615f1a4c 63f55e38c7` (three-dot): 8 path(s).
    origin/main = b3615f1a4c, claude/issue-19572-write-pace = 63f55e38c7, merge-base = b3615f1a4c.
    size: +1082 / -0 over 8 file(s) (0 binary, counted 0) — `git diff --numstat --no-renames` on the same range.
governed-surface predicate: 0 of 8 path(s) hit the register (6 surfaces, repo-agnostic).
  ✅  NOT governed — ordinary queue landing applies to a PR with exactly this file list.
      Derived from GOVERNED_SURFACES, not recalled. Re-run on the FINAL file list: the register
      has grown several times in two days, and a reading taken earlier in the session is recall.
  ⚠️  head repo: NOT MEASURED — this verdict cannot tell a fork PR from an internal one; `--pr PR-NUMBER` reads it.
  size: 1082 changed line(s) (+1082 / -0) ≤ 5000 — under the human-merge threshold (generated files included in the count).
```

(Verbatim, with one exception: the tool prints its `--pr` placeholder in angle brackets, respelled here
as `PR-NUMBER` because this platform's body sanitizer eats short angle-bracket fragments, fenced or not.)

⚠️ **The card says Tier S; the register says NOT governed.** #19572's body reads
"`scripts/pm/**`, Tier S — the director seat lands it after an at-tier read", but `GOVERNED_SURFACES`
does not list `scripts/pm/**`, and AGENTS.md Prime Directive #14 makes that table — not a card — the
authority ("adding a surface is an edit *there*"). This is reported, not acted on in either
direction: no seat here arms anything, and nothing was added to the register on this branch. The
owning seat decides whether the discrepancy is a card that overstated the tier or a register that is
missing a row.

## Changeset

`skip-changeset`. The diff is `scripts/pm/**`, `.github/workflows/lint.yml` and one root
`package.json` script alias — **nothing under `packages/**`**, so no released package's `files[]`
ships one byte of it and there is nothing to publish.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么。** 给 PM 的五个写工具装了一道共享节流阀:每次 POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE 发出之前先问它
"现在能写吗",答完再把平台的回答喂回去。同一个 token 两次写之间至少隔 3 秒(不够就补睡),一小时
最多 40 次,第 41 次直接拒绝并打印处方;平台一旦发出 429 或二级限流信号,30 分钟内(或它要求的更长
时间)这个 token 的写全部被拒。

**为什么改。** 维护者 2026-09-21 的裁决「截流应该要加」。当天有两个席位账号在批量操作 issue 时被
平台停用。此前五个工具里没有任何一个会计数或限速——只有 `label-write.mjs` 会在事后把 429 归类。

**风险与代价(含回滚)。** 最大的代价是:预算用尽时席位会被硬拒(退出码 10),而不是等。这是刻意的
——在写路径里睡一小时是带借口的挂起。回滚成本很低:这是一次纯增量,五个工具各只多了两行调用和一个
import,`git revert` 即可;真要临时放宽,`OS_PM_WRITE_HOURLY_MAX` 可以在不改代码的情况下抬高(该
开关声明为"仅供测试",抬它属于维护者的行为,不是席位的)。锁是 fail-open 的,拿不到锁绝不会挡住
写入,只会让计数不那么精确。

**席位意见。** (待席位填写)

**你要做的。** 只有一件:确认 40 次/小时与 3 秒这两个数字是你想要的。它们现在是合同(env 覆盖只对
测试成立),改它们要动代码。另外请看上面「Landing tier」一节标出的卡片与登记表不一致。
